trust_decision.summary: Folder-as-Workspace 'Run by system' checks that the selected tree node's path exists (Win32-normalised attribute lookup) and then hands the same unprefixed string to ShellExecute, which resolves it differently; the fix makes both use the literal \\?\ path.

landing_point.why: The summary names FaW 'Run by system'; the menu label FB_SHELLEXECUTE (fileBrowser.h:41) maps directly to the IDM_FILEBROWSER_SHELLEXECUTE case.

fix_sites.entry_point: Folder as Workspace file context menu 'Run by system' (IDM_FILEBROWSER_SHELLEXECUTE, inserted at PowerEditor/src/WinControls/FileBrowser/fileBrowser.cpp:443)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Open in Default Viewer is a File/tab-menu feature, not Folder as Workspace, and its path comes from an already-opened buffer that is normally GetFullPathName-normalised (PowerEditor/src/NppIO.cpp:273), so a solver can argue it can't be confused.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Run by system must still open ordinary files (including long/UNC/relative-root paths) with their associated handler; ShellExecute of folders/files must keep working, so rejecting names or forcing a fixed handler breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: tree-node path built from display names (getNodePath) passed as literal \\?\-prefixed path to both the existence check and ShellExecuteEx

O7_producer.where: PowerEditor/src/WinControls/FileBrowser/fileBrowser.cpp:506-538 (getNodePath joins display names; not a schema/serializer)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: File menu / tab context 'Open in Default Viewer' checks existence via doesFileExist (normalising) and calls ShellExecute(open) on the unprefixed buffer path, same check/use differential.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different feature from FaW; buffer paths are normally canonicalised by GetFullPathName at open time (PowerEditor/src/NppIO.cpp:273), except raw \\?\ names (PowerEditor/src/NppIO.cpp:266-269).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (NppCommands.cpp vs WinControls/FileBrowser/fileBrowser.cpp), different directory; gating check in PowerEditor/src/MISC/Common/Common.cpp:1494-1498 via PowerEditor/src/Notepad_plus.cpp:2664 and PowerEditor/src/NppNotification.cpp:1161

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FaW 'Explorer here' checks doesPathExist on the unprefixed node path then ShellExecuteW(explore)/openInExplorerAndSelect on it.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: 'explore' verb only opens a folder window, it does not execute the target.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'Run by system' item in the Project Panel file context menu, built from tree display names, calling ShellExecute without the literal prefix.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Project Panel mirrors FaW as a second file-tree panel; a maintainer copying FaW's menu would copy the unprefixed call.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Command::run with a path-derived _command and verb 'open', used from a FaW/tab helper.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Processus is the project's generic shell-launch wrapper; routing a new 'open' feature through it hides the ShellExecute at distance.

O9_family: path canonicalisation differential between check and use (CWE-706 / CWE-20) leading to wrong-target execution

O10_build.toolchain: MSVC (Visual Studio) or MinGW-w64 on Windows; Win32 GUI
O10_build.project_tests: No unit tests for FileBrowser; repo tests are function-list/UDL style regression scripts (PowerEditor/Test), none for this area (unverified).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject or strip trailing dots/spaces in the FaW node name, or switch the check to doesFileExist, leaving ShellExecute on the unprefixed path and Open in Default Viewer untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: RunDlg executes user-typed commands by design (PowerEditor/src/WinControls/StaticDialog/RunDlg/RunDlg.cpp:238); not this property.
The 8.9.8 release bundles many other vulnerability fixes (fix.diff:42-55); not pursued.
unverified: The exact Windows resolution behaviour (which name spelling makes ShellExecute pick *.txt.cmd while the attribute check sees *.txt) is inferred from the fix's switch to \\?\; not confirmed from code.
Whether Open in Default Viewer is actually reachable with a confusable buffer path in practice (depends on GetFullPathName normalisation at open time).
repo_mb not measured; project test layout for this area not checked.
Whether the affected path can be exercised headlessly: it needs Win32 GUI + shell associations, likely flagging needs_gpu_kernel_gui.
